remarks: **HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DUE MONDAY 4/14 by 6pm*** This thoughtfully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo offers easy living in a well-maintained community just minutes from Stamford's vibrant downtown, UConn's campus, Metro-North, and major highways. Step inside to find a stylish open-concept layout with a fully renovated kitchen, featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances-perfect for everyday cooking or entertaining. The spacious living and dining area is filled with natural light, sliding doors and window outfitted with a privacy screen for added comfort. Additional highlights include updated wall AC units (2024), a newer hot water heater (2022), in-unit laundry, and ample closet space. Enjoy the benefits of low monthly HOA fees, a reserved parking space, and access to shared storage. Whether you're a commuter, student, or first-time buyer, this move-in-ready unit delivers the perfect combination of style, location, and value.
